user_story: As a user, I want to see my profile information after logging in so that I can confirm my account details.

positive.title: User can view profile information after logging in successfully
steps: Verify that the profile information is displayed
positive.expected_result: The user sees their profile information displayed correctly on the screen.

negative.title: User cannot view profile information with invalid credentials
steps: Enter an invalid username or password
Verify that the profile information is not displayed
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials, and no profile information is shown.

edge.title: User attempts to log in with empty credentials
steps: Leave username and password fields empty
Verify that the profile information is not displayed
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that fields cannot be empty, and no profile information is shown.
